Warm, friendly and delicious welcome to Dong Hoi!
Sep 2026 • Couples
Terrific little cafe/restaurant, located just on the right as you exit the main railway station in Dong Hoi.

The lovely owner, who speaks excellent English, as well as Mandarin, serves a very good range of local and western food, as well as various juices, smoothies, beers and hot drinks, all at very reasonable prices. The food that we had was delicious, with very fresh ingredients and it is spotlessly clean.

The owner can also arrange motorbike rentals for 200,000 VND but you may need the International Driving Permit. They also appear to offer tours to Phong Nha and other local cave networks and I am sure will try to help with any other queries that visitors may have.

A Must-Visit Gem of a Cafe Near Dong Hoi Station!
Apr 2025 • Couples
Absolutely fantastic little spot! Sophie Homy Cafe and Food is a hidden gem just steps from Dong Hoi train station—literally less than a minute’s walk. We stopped in for a bite and were blown away by the amazingly delicious omelette banh mi—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly made. The host was incredibly warm, welcoming, and friendly, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. Whether you’re just arriving in Dong Hoi or waiting for a train, this place is an absolute must-visit. Highly recommended!
